data.why: The repo bundles example FASTA files in data/ that are listed directly in the sidebar's 'Or choose an example' selectbox, so no synthetic data is needed.

goals: Load a FASTA file (upload or pick a bundled example) and view per-sequence nucleotide/amino acid composition and GC content
Test whether a sequence's base/residue distribution is statistically homogeneous using a chi-square test
Compare two sequences from an uploaded multi-FASTA file via a dotplot alignment at a chosen window size
Identify regions of local similarity (diagonal matches) between two nucleotide sequences visually

review.summary: The tree fits the README's purpose closely: load a FASTA file, describe composition with GC content and a chi-square uniformity test, and compare two nucleotide records with a windowed dotplot. Its phases, features and evidence are mostly sound. It needs small fixes before filing: one mis-cited screen for the PNG export, branch markers in the wrong places, a missing self-comparison task, and unstated limits on what the dotplot and GC numbers can tell you.
